chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: 'Five characteristics: whoever lacks one of them will remain with an incomplete life, unstable intellect, and a distracted heart.'
The first is health of the body, the second is security, the third is abundance in sustenance, and the fourth is a sympathetic companion.
I asked: 'And who is the sympathetic companion?' He said: 'A righteous wife, a righteous child, and a righteous companion.'
And the fifth, which encompasses these characteristics, is comfort (peace of mind).

key_terms.الدَّعَةُ: Comfort, tranquility, or ease of mind; a state of inner peace.
key_terms.مَشْغُولَ الْقَلْبِ: Distracted or preoccupied in the heart.
key_terms.نَاقِصَ الْعَيْشِ: Having an incomplete or deficient life.

ai.seo_question: What are the five characteristics that ensure a complete life and peace of mind according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Khisal*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this hadith to illustrate the holistic nature of human well-being, linking physical and material stability with spiritual serenity. The concept of 'al-Daw'ah' (tranquility) is presented not merely as an emotion but as the unifying state that validates the other four pillars, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the interdependence of bodily health, social security, and inner peace. This enumeration serves as a practical framework for evaluating one's spiritual and worldly progress.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-35 He (MGB) also said, “Anyone who doesn’t have one of the following will always have an incomplete life; be unwise and always worried:
health, security; abundance of daily bread; a sympathetic companion.”
He (MGB) was asked, “Who would constitute a sympathetic companion?” He (MGB) replied, “A good wife; a good child or a good friend.
And the last thing which includes all the others is comfort.”
